episodes.synopsis: Nao Ippongi is a rookie police officer who finds herself partnered with the ornery psychic policeman, Chojo.
episodes.title: The Psychic Patrolman

episodes.synopsis: A visitor to the station asks Chojo and Ippongi to find her cat.
episodes.title: The Cat-Finding Senior Officer / Senior Duelist Officer

episodes.synopsis: Chojo and Ippongi get a new coworker, who might be more than meets the eye.
episodes.title: The Gofer Senior Officer / Racing Senior Officer

episodes.synopsis: Chojo's old partner, Yuki Inukai, comes to the West Shinjuku station.
episodes.title: The Leave-on-Read Senior Patrolman / The Quiz Senior Patrolman

episodes.synopsis: The West Chinjuku station staff fill in for a convenience store plagued by a shoplifter.
episodes.title: Convenience Store Patrolman / Pubescent Patrolman

episodes.synopsis: There's a Cherry Blossom Festival in Chinjuku, and Chojo has the day off--but he's still causing trouble.
episodes.title: The Festival Senior Patrolman

episodes.synopsis: When Chojo's bad reputation becomes too much of a hindrance, he gets a new costumed identity to work under.
episodes.title: The Transforming Senior Patrolman

episodes.synopsis: Chojo works through his frustration by trolling kids at an arcade, and Ippongi has a date.
episodes.title: The Kid-Eliminating Senior Patrolman / The Chaperone Senior Patrolman
